title: Onboarding model-discovery spotlight and tiered-cost overlay for release notes
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Create a focused set of onboarding and release-note visuals that illustrate a new model discovery 'spotlight' card and an interactive tiered-cost overlay. Assets should be optimized for use in release notes, product docs, and the Console quickstart. The spotlight is a condensed hero strip that highlights new or deprecated models with a concise reason, sample latency/cost metrics, and a CTA to 'Try in Console' or 'Pin to Project'. The tiered-cost overlay shows token cost projections across three common usage patterns (exploratory, production-low-volume, production-high-volume) mapped to pricing tiers and recommended model variants (quantized / standard). This ticket covers copy annotations, responsive screenshots (desktop/tablet/mobile), light/dark theme variants, and localized strings for EN/FR/DE.
acceptance_criteria: One master Figma file with named frames for: spotlight-card (desktop/tablet/mobile), tiered-cost-overlay (desktop/tablet/mobile), deprecation-badge states, and CTA variants
Exported PNG/JPEG screenshots at 2x and 3x for all frames, organized in release-ready folders
Annotated copy + callouts documented in Confluence with links to Console routes for QA
Design handoff checklist completed and linked PR created to update docs site assets
PM and Engineering approvals obtained for data surfaced in the overlay (cost numbers, latency ranges)
assets_needed: localized strings file (EN/FR/DE) and screenshots with translated copy
deprecation badge set (warning, sunset date, migration CTA)
